components.name: Command Tile
components.description: Square launcher action with a precise selected signal.
components.css: .ds-command-tile{display:grid;place-items:center;width:96px;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-radius:6px;color:var(--color-text-primary,rgba(255,255,255,.92));background:var(--color-tile,#191d24);box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.055),inset 0 -1px rgba(0,0,0,.38),0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3);font:560 12px/1.22 Inter,sans-serif;text-align:center;transition:transform 100ms,border-color 100ms,background 100ms}.ds-command-tile svg{width:30px;height:30px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-command-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:var(--color-tile-hover,#202631)}.ds-command-tile:focus-visible{outline:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.52);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-command-tile[aria-selected=true]{border-color:var(--color-accent,#f36a2d);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.68),0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}

components.name: Alphabet Control
components.description: Narrow catalog navigation with an exact one-pixel active indicator.
components.css: .ds-alpha{display:grid;width:32px;border-left:1px solid var(--color-border,rgba(255,255,255,.08));background:var(--color-window,#101216)}.ds-alpha button{position:relative;height:22px;border:0;color:var(--color-text-muted,rgba(255,255,255,.4));background:transparent;font:600 10px Inter,sans-serif}.ds-alpha button.active{color:var(--color-accent,#f36a2d)}.ds-alpha button.active:before{position:absolute;inset:25% auto 25% -1px;width:1px;background:var(--color-accent,#f36a2d);content:''}.ds-alpha button:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--color-accent,#f36a2d);outline-offset:-1px}.ds-alpha button:disabled{opacity:.25}

narrative.overview: Clackly is a compact professional control surface that appears inside the editor's existing Resolve workflow, performs one focused job, and gets out of the way. Dark tonal layers, hairlines, and rare orange signals preserve scanability under sustained editing use.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral layers separated by tone and hairline borders
Orange reserved for identity, focus, selection, and pinned state
Small controlled radii and a consistent lucide-react line-icon vocabulary
Fast motion that confirms state without becoming decoration

rules.name: The Orange Signal Rule
rules.body: Use orange only for identity, focus, active selection, pinned indicators, and essential state; never fill a full tile with it.

rules.name: The Two-Line Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Command labels use at most two lines and metadata truncates before density is lost.

rules.name: The Workspace Preservation Rule
rules.body: Every mode occupies only the space required for its current task.

dos: Do preserve complete keyboard operation and visible focus or selection.
Do preserve the path-only custom SVG wordmark and mark, and use lucide-react SVG components for interface icons.
Do center launcher icons and one/two-line labels as one command unit.
Do label demo content as unavailable prototype data.
donts: Don't use large glow, full-orange tiles, gradient text, or decorative glass.
Don't use SVG text or font-dependent rendering for the CLACKLY wordmark.
Don't use radii above 16px or consumer-launcher whitespace.
Don't let renderer UI know how Resolve actions are implemented.
